reviews.comment: I love Singh he's got to be the best professor I've ever had. He cares so much about the class and students succeeding. Don't listen to the other reviews he's literality my goat. You better take him I'd take a bullet for my goat.

He doesn't help nor hurt the learning process thus its on you to teach yourself the material. I tried to see him during his office hours but he never showed, and he never responded to any emails. He waited to grade the final and project (50% of final grade) until the final hour of the semester and didn't even telling us the grade we received.

Professor Singh has an excellent teaching style. He is clear, consistent, and well-organized, He is also a highly respected individual who maintains professionalism in and out of the classroom.many of the negative comments posted about him are demeaning and do not reflect factual or accurate observations of his teaching or character.

This class was a fever dream. Lectures were often rushed and I almost never learned anything. Made up for it by being insanely generous on exams. 1 HW, 1 rec, and 1 bonus question and partial credit. HW is graded on completion, and project is not graded tough. He's chill and oddly funny, and whole class ended up on random inside jokes. Read book.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Professor Singh was difficult to understand, and his lectures often felt disorganized and hard to follow. He mumbled often, and did not always articulate concepts clearly. 

I also found it difficult to engage fully in the class due to concerns I became aware of regarding his abusive treatment of graduate students.
I love Singh. As long as you read book you'll be ok. Sometimes he's just makes the tests too easy

Prof is absolute buns. Doesn't teach concepts in class, so be sure to read the textbook before lecture. There's only one quiz and it's worth 15% of the grade for some reason (so it's basically a midterm), and all the quizzes and exams are pretty difficult.

Read the book and you'll be fine, but don't expect the prof to help you learn the content.

I think this class is too easy sometimes, almost like he's trolling us. Just do homework, and exams will be easy breezey *yawn*. Come to class, but make sure you put all distractions away (no virtual class, he will feel cheated on). Shoutout to avneesh, made the class amazing.

He is literally amazing! 100000/10 would take again! Just make sure you read book, and he won't troll. He makes tests/quizzes too easy sometimes, but isn't shy to say he feels bad about it. 

Would recommend! I don't understand the hate about the earlier reviews (he changed a lot).
Literally my goat!!!! Class was a delight every time. The tests were too easy. It even seemed like he was trolling me with how easy they were.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Singh isn't the best lecturer, but he follows the textbook almost word for word. He expects you to read the chapter before class, so during lectures he quickly reviews the concepts and moves goes into examples. I struggled for most of the semester and even considered dropping, but he is excellent 1 on 1 in office hours if you're having trouble.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Singh is not as bad as some of these reviews make him out to be. Thermodynamics is a difficult course, the beginning being the most difficult part due to the heavy amount of concepts that are thrown around and introduced. Singh is not a bad professor; if you participate, ask questions in lecture, and read the book, you will be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst prof at A&M. Showed up to teach 60% of the time, otherwise left it to TA or Substitutes. Fell way behind on material and crammed all midterm material into one week, then the mid-term was not even on material we covered. Most failed by 30 points. Ask a question in his class he thinks is "obvious" he responds with "you're trolling me right?"
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the worst professor I have had in my life. For reference, I am high-school valedictorian, auto admit into aero department, and top 95% of my class at A&M, and this was by far the worst class I have ever had. Everyone failed the mid-term by 30-50 points, and I am now FORCED to Q-drop. Singh did not show up to teach, and students suffer.

Dr. Singh is very receptive to feedback and criticism and will adapt his teaching style to cater to the students' needs. He is very particular about going through example problems in class. There are two quizzes in this class that are high-stakes but other than that, you are allowed cheat sheets for exams that will help you out a ton.

Let's say this: Avoid him if you value your grade very much. By the spring system of 2025, he will be teaching for the second time. He had many, and I do mean many faults, and while he is nice about it, he admits that he doesn't fully know what he is doing. If you have disabilities, then be prepared to email him multiple times.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Most of the class will not make sense until the last three weeks when you go over cycles. Then everything starts making sense and you will feel a bit like an idiot for having not understood it for the previous exam and two quizzes. Not sure if this is the prof's fault, but that might just be how thermo is.

reviews.comment: Dr. Singh is a great professor. He tries his best to help each and every student improve. Very accessible outside of class and is hilarious. Overall amazing.
Professor Singh can sometimes be hit or miss with his lectures, but he explains concepts well through examples. Reading the textbook is helpful. Grading is pretty lenient, and there can be curves.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Homeboy puts like 3 questions on his quizzes and exams and when we attend class afterwards, he hits us with the "this one was pretty easy" when the quiz was like a 50 average. You want to sit up close in his class due to his faint and slim handwriting.
Good professor, although a newer teacher so requires student's asking questions to help him understand what we don't understand. Regularly interacts with the classroom
Really hard class, but Singh makes it enjoyable to go to. Have to use outside resources and have a good equation sheet to pass.
if you read the book and know how to set stuff up, you're golden. otherwise you're kinda cooked.
